correctness.rationale: For generic triangle interiors the primary theorem counts two alternating extrema for each active perpendicular edge foot. With the obtuse apex at the origin, the two independent projection inequalities cut a wedge whose BC base fractions are computed exactly, giving the stated F. Algebra verifies the exact fixed-angle extremizer and stability. Extended real limits follow from F=(1-k²)/(1+k²+k(q+q^-1)); every limit is constructively realized. Standalone verification.py passed exact Fraction cases, 24 independently clipped-area cases, 72,000 direct point normal counts and nine boundary-layer checks. The finite tests are supporting, not a substitute for the proof.

value.rationale: The 2024 primary paper specifically proposes average normal multiplicity as a shape statistic and leaves obtuse triangle means qualitatively bounded. An exact entire distribution is a natural complete classification. Its sharp fixed-angle rigidity quantifies sensitivity to triangle shape, while the joint right-angle boundary layer shows that the informal limit towards six is nonuniform for degenerate aspect ratios; the full [4,6] accumulation interval is a structural singular perturbation rather than a routine normalization.
